case_number: 2024 INSC 530; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. OF 2024 (@ Special Leave to Petition (Crl.) Nos.672-675 OF 2024, CRL. APPEAL NOS…………/2024@ SLP(CRL.) NOS.672-675/2024)
summary: Interim maintenance arrears in domestic violence case; marriage irretrievably broken down after nine years separation; standard for dissolution on irretrievable breakdown; multiple failed mediations; respondent's non-payment since 5½ years; High Court's 20% arrears order challenged; mutual consent divorce granted as reconciliation impossible; final maintenance quantum to be determined by Metropolitan Magistrate within three months.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.498A, s.323, s.504
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 s.12, s.23, s.31(1)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; mutual consent divorce granted; interim maintenance order modified (20% arrears upheld); complete attachment rejected; Metropolitan Magistrate to determine final monthly maintenance within three months.
